  val limit: Float <const> = <expr>
  annotation class Measure(val single: Float = 1.000000059604644775390625000001, val wide: Double = -0.0)
  annotation class Limits(val low: Float32 = Float.MIN_VALUE, val high: Double = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
    @Measure
    @Limits
  struct Sample
    @Measure(limit, wide = +0.1)
    field value: Float
    @Measure(-0f, wide = Double.NaN)
  enum Reading
    One(@Measure(0.1, wide = 1e40) Float)
    Empty
    @Measure(+0.1f, wide = -1e-300)
  class Sensor(@Limits val calibration: Double)
